Satellite mechanisms

Reflect Orbital

Drag spool test rig

I designed the assembly in Onshape, integrated the electronics, and wrote the Python code to measure resistive force and natural frequency during deployment. The team used my test results in the Eärendil-2 mechanical design and concept of operations.

Drag spool level winder

I built and programmed a level winder that held final spool diameter variation below 2%. It was used to wind the Eärendil-2 flight drag spools. I documented the manufacturing process so the team could repeat it.

Watch the drag spool level winder video ↗

Halyard spool test rig

I designed a rig and Python interface to measure how a thin steel ribbon packed onto its spool and deployed. The tests characterized packing factor and eccentricity and informed controls decisions for Eärendil-1 and Eärendil-2.

Watch the halyard spool test rig video ↗

Test hardware

Rice University Wind Tunnel

Settling chamber and instrumentation

I designed the settling chamber, pitot tube attachment, and test section braces in SolidWorks. I built a prototype to check how the wire mesh screens could attach to the chamber while limiting air leaks.

Assembly and analysis

I used finite element analysis to check the structure. Our team completed the full tunnel CAD assembly so we could move toward fabrication.

Wind energy

Wind Turbine Blades

Choosing the blade geometry

I researched airfoils and helped write MATLAB code to calculate chord and twist along the blade using Schmitz optimization. I modeled the resulting geometry in QBlade.

Prototype and competition

I printed a PLA prototype and helped resin-print the competition blades. Our Rice Wind Energy team placed second overall at the 2025 Collegiate Wind Competition.

Competition robotics

VEX Spin Up Robot

Design and build

I led design and development decisions, helped model the final robot in SolidWorks using VEX part files, and built and upgraded the hardware for the 2022–23 Spin Up season.

Competition and documentation

I kept a notebook of our design decisions and chassis construction. Our team won the Texas UIL 6A Regional Championship and Texas Region 2 State Championship, earning the state Build Award. We qualified for Worlds in 2022 and 2023. In 2023 we finished as division finalists and earned a Judges Award.

Combat robotics

One-Pound Battlebot

Design and competition

I helped model the chassis and electronics in Onshape, printed several PLA prototypes to check fit, and helped solder the wheel motors to the electronic speed controller. Our team placed second in a local competition at Rice.
